fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-05-23 states that a rented premises near Nallur Park Main Street was allegedly occupied by a person after the lease ended, and the keys were not returned, on 2025-05-13 at about 14:15. The complainant, Rajeshwari Ammal, provided the contact number 9000000242. The complainant alleged that Karthik Thangaraj may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000053. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Premises allegedly occupied after the lease period ended.
fields.Keywords: illegal occupation, lease dispute, afternoon, suspect, main street, mobile number, documents
